title: Grant authority
description: Tell NIVO what you want, how to speak for your business, and what it may do alone. Everything else, it asks you.
goalsDesc: Revenue, customers and how fast you want to reply. The dashboard measures real results against these.
goalRevenueHint: Leave empty if you have no target yet.
goalNoteHint: For example: focus on B2B service customers this quarter.
policiesDesc: Business rules, reply style and brand voice. Every AI department follows these.
policiesHint: One rule per line, for example: no discount above 10 percent.
replyStyleHint: For example: short, polite, address the customer formally.
brandVoiceHint: For example: friendly, clear, no exaggerated promises.
scopeDesc: What each AI department may do by itself. Auto acts alone, Ask first waits for you, Never is not allowed.
instancesShared: Applies to every agent of this type: {names}. Rules are set per agent type, not per branch or page.
limitHint: At this amount or above, NIVO asks you. Empty means no limit.
limitsDesc: What needs your opinion first. If a required detail is missing, NIVO asks instead of guessing.
limitsNoteHint: For example: a new customer wants a price outside the list, or a refund.
requiredHint: For each action, NIVO asks you when one of these details is missing.
staffDesc: You do not need staff to approve routine work. Staff can take over a conversation or handle an exception.
staffEmpty: No staff yet. Add someone only if you want to hand exceptions to a person.
readOnlyBody: Only the owner and managers can change authority. You can read it here.
loadFailBody: The authority settings are not available yet. Try again in a moment.
